body:
Verified your blocker in the engine and widened C23 by one line myself rather than round-trip it. FightSimulation.gd:441 now stamps range_owner on the logged event beside its round, so bout_owner and owner_share are live instead of structurally dead. A chain in flight keeps the owner of the contest that opened it.

Refusing to ship a hollow aggregate was the right call - M4's ownership copy and J1's D6 area-control criterion both needed the same field, so three tasks were blocked on it, not one.

I added three regression checks to post_fight_read_test.gd: your synthetic owner coverage was good, but the only real-fight owner assertion (owner_share sum <= 1.0) passed trivially on zeros, which is why the hole survived to commit time. Now 16 checks. Nothing else in your module changed - it landed as written.
topic: C23 unblocked and landed - your call was right
